card.name: Isotope mass numbers like Rb 82
card.fires_on: The space or digit just before the mass number of a radioactive isotope, such as the 82 in Rubidium Rb 82 or Sr 82, and the 68 in gallium Ga 68. It appears in generator and radiopharmaceutical text.

modes.label: Space before mass number
modes.description: The gap between the element symbol and its mass number, such as Rb or Sr before 82.

modes.label: Digit inside mass number
modes.description: The first digit or letter of the number in an isotope name, such as 8 in Rb 82 or 6 in Ga 68.

card.writes: It suppresses radio-related words, so it appears to hold back repeating radiation terms right after an isotope name.
card.plain: It marks the spot in an isotope name like Rb 82 where the mass number comes next.
